Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in a commercial parking lot in Pearland, Texas. On arrival,
Driver 1 and Driver 2 were standing beside their vehicles, and both stated that the collision occurred as described
when one vehicle backed out of a parking space and struck the side of the other. Several bystanders who saw the
impact gave consistent accounts, and a witness ponited out the position of the vehicles before they were moved.
Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the rear quarter panel of the vehicle driven by Driver 1, and the
location and pattern of the damage match the impact described by all parties. No earlier damage to either vehicle was
reported or observed. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both the
responding officers and the witnesses confirmed Passenger's presence at the time of the collision. Passenger
reported pain in the wrist and was transported for evaluation. Officers note that it is not yet clear whether the wrist
injury resulted from this collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle, and the
documents presented at the scene were reviewed.

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
